meta.title: Wild Shape Animal List by Environment
meta.subtitle: Coniferous forest, mountain, cave, and grounded bird forms — CR 1 and under

intro: This table is meant to help a player choose forms during play.

statRule.title: Wild Shape Stat Rule
statRule.lead: When you Wild Shape, you use the beast’s:
keepDruid: class/racial features if the form can physically use them
statRule.note: For saving throws and ability checks, use the beast’s physical stats, but keep the druid’s mental stats. So if the animal has bad Wisdom, that usually does not matter. The druid keeps their own Wisdom while Wild Shaped.

envs.label: Grounded Birds
envs.title: Grounded Bird Forms Before Flight
envs.note: These bird forms are allowed for shape and flavor, but they do not grant functional flight until the druid unlocks flying Wild Shape.

dm_note.title: DM Note on Grounded Birds
may: perch if it can reach the perch normally
flap for balance, intimidation, display, or flavor
look and behave like a normal bird while grounded
dm_note.may_not_intro: A grounded bird form may not:
dm_note.footer: At most, the bird may flutter enough to handle a very short drop, such as 10 feet or less, at the DM’s discretion.
